notes.title: Community contests winners!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FDguJ3P.png[/img]

Hi, crew members!
Thank you for joining us in celebrating the 'Hollow' premiere. It's been a very busy end of the year for us, we'd like to thank you once again for being there with us and your continuous support for the developers! Hopefully 'Hollow' will grow even further with your help, see you all on Steam forums!
----------------

We're happy to announce the winners of our community contests!

[b]Hollow Release - community contest[/b]
Thank you for sending us your gameplays, the winners were selected according to the order of applications sent to us via e-mail:

1. qvaku - original 'Hollow' soundtrack, syringe-like pen, official 'Hollow' t-shirt, monster figurine, and ID card from the game.
2. lapin killer - original 'Hollow' soundtrack, syringe-like pen, official 'Hollow' t-shirt, and ID card from the game.
3. iChipsy - original 'Hollow' soundtrack, syringe-like pen, and ID card from the game.

Congratulations to all the winners, we will contact you via e-mail very soon, thank you again for participating in our contest!
----------------

[b]Hollow theories - community contest[/b]
We'd like to thank iChipsy for sending us an in-depth explanation of what happened on board Shakhter-One! The reward (original 'Hollow' soundtrack, syringe-like pen, official 'Hollow' t-shirt, monster figurine, and ID card from the game) will be sent to you very soon, congratulations!

[i]You can read the contest entry below:[/i]
Mark had to enter the hospital due to a mental illness(we can see this being the reason due to it being stated in a divorce decree). While Mark spent years in the hospital, Sara decided that the best thing to do was starting a new life far away from Mark and therefore boarded the Shakhter-One.

Shakhter-One is a space rocket ship dedicated to minery. It was built by russians using cheap sources of labour and gain benefits from it as fast as possible. This ship landed in Jupiter to start the extraction of the minerals, and, unluckily, one of the planet's compound was unknown and had a chemical composition close to the one heroine has. The systems were unable to purify this compound and before the crew could notice, they were being infected.

When Mark exit the hospital , following Sara, he boarded the Shakhter-One aswell. In this ship, he worked as a pilot and as when the virus spread across the crew he got infected. Sara, despite of everything she suffered when they were married, helped him to escape so that Mark wouldn’t have to face the same destiny the infected ones had to.

Mark, due to one of the virus symptoms, forgot about what happened and came back to the ship crashing against the Shakhter-One in the endless search of Sara (we can see the crashed ship before fall down in Cables' maze).

Mark was being chased by the Shakhter-One tripulation so, he decided to hide himself on the Cables' maze and wait for the situation to calm down. While this was happening, Sara was enclosed for helped Mark to escape from Shakhter-One.

Whole the situation makes Sara fall ill and for this reason the tripulation thought that Sara was infected and they enclosed her in an isolation cell with the infected ones (for this reason Sara sometimes says: ''I wasn't infected, you were the infected one, Mark''). Sara couldn't resist anymore so she decided to kill herself because she knew that Mark never would stop until recover Sara and she dindn't want to stay with him anymore, she wanted to start a new life.

Mark was still hiding in the cables' maze therefore finally he died because of the UC. It is a virus which makes people become crazy and see things that  are not really there. For this reason they make things like suicide, homicide and cannibalism.

The UC can kill your body but it can not kill your souls but it can harrow it. So, the ones who get killed by the UC, are doomed to wander for their darkest and deeper thoughts. For this reason at the start of the game Mark says: ''I don't know who I am or even if this happened before. If this hapenned before, I could remember it, right?''

When we arrive at the cables' maze, we can discover that our guide in the game, Mike, is really ourself in another time. He said: ''We have tried to do this another times but the UC always reached us so we had to start again''.

This is what we exactly see at the final A of the game. We destroy the Shakhter-One but this is not real, the really Shakhter-One is wandering near Jupiter (that is the unknown planet which we can see when the reaper reached us) and the real Mark is dead in the cables' maze. So the UC reset our mind and we have to start the same story again.

In the case of Mark, he is doomed to wander in the search of Sara for his eternity because he couldn't let Sara go in the real life and his soul can not do it so, he will be living the same torture again and again. For this reason at the final B of the game we can hear Sara saying: ''I couldn't resist anymore so I killed myself Mark. You have to stop this, I am dead and you can not make me your demon for the rest of the eternity''.

Therefore, Mark's soul is trapped in an infinite loop where he is trying to recover Sara and repair his errors in the past and where he is close to the nightmare's end the UC just reset his mind and he has to start again.

notes.title: Hollow optimization patch
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/t1lWgKt.jpg[/img]

Podczas tygodnia po premierze Hollow, obserwowaliśmy forum Steam by poznać Wasze opinie. Jednym z głównych problemów, które nam zgłaszaliście była optymalizacja gry. Przyjrzeliśmy się temu i podjęliśmy wszelkich starań by to poprawić - by móc zapewnić Wam rozrywkę na najwyższym poziomie.

Dzisiejsza aktualizacja to wynik dalszej pracy nad optymalizacją, który powinien w znacznym stopniu poprawić wydajność gry. Ilość FPS powinna zauważalnie wzrosnąć przy wszystkich ustawieniach graficznych i konfiguracjach sprzętowych powyżej minimalnych wymagań.

Czekamy na dalsze sugestie z Waszej strony! Odwiedźcie forum Steam i dajcie nam znać, co sądzicie o dzisiejszej aktualizacji - http://steamcommunity.com/app/590970/discussions/

notes.title: Hollow optimization patch
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/t1lWgKt.jpg[/img]

During the week following Hollow premiere, we've been looking on Steam forums for your feedback and suggestions. One of the main problems you were reporting was game optimization, and we took our time to look into this issue and to work on it - to provide you the best gaming experience possible.

Today's update is a further gameplay optimization that will [b]greatly improve your game performance.[/b] The change in FPS count should be noticeable on all settings and hardware configurations above the minimal requirements.

We are looking forward to hearing from you. Visit Steam forums and leave us your feedback on the newest update! - http://steamcommunity.com/app/590970/discussions/

notes.title: New Patch - Keybinding!

Thank you for your feedback, we're happy to hear from you. You may report bugs and share with us your ideas on how to improve the gameplay on our Steam forums - http://steamcommunity.com/app/590970/discussions/0/3183345000079426150

notes.title: Day 0!!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27822343/643db3d97cca0f5afe198d20d38c4aca01ac63f1.jpg[/img]

We are celebrating Hollow release and to do it even better we prepared for you two contests. Details below:


[b]Hollow Release - community contest[/b]
---------------------
You lay your hands down on the game. Yes, finally, it's here! Do you feel the thrills and chills? Do you shake uncontrollably? Do you feel the sweat drops?

Hmm, it might be something wrong with you. Did you take the vaccine?
Remember, avoid the illusions.
---------------------

To celebrate 'Hollow' premiere, we have prepared something exceptional for you! We're launching the community contest, that gives you a chance to win a unique 'Hollow' merchandise!

[b]Rules:[/b]
1. Record a video with final battle and second ending (yes, the mystery is revealed, Hollow has 2 endings! Curious now?)
2. Send it to us at pr@forever-entertainment.com
3. The contest starts at 16 November 2017 at 21:30 CET, and ends on 10 December 2017 at 23:59 CET
4. The first 10 people will be named as winners!

[b]Prize:[/b]
I place: original 'Hollow' soundtrack, syringe-like pen, official 'Hollow' t-shirt, monster figurine, and ID card from the game.

II place: original 'Hollow' soundtrack, syringe-like pen, official 'Hollow' t-shirt, and ID card from the game.

III place: original 'Hollow' soundtrack, syringe-like pen, and ID card from the game.

IV - X place: original 'Hollow' soundtrack and syringe-like pen.


Don't miss your chance, good luck!
-------
[b]Read contest rules here:[/b] https://www.dropbox.com/sh/jsd7jpf6ucnn2m3/AACBK_htTT_gdvHh1mw9AvQMa?dl=0


[img]https://i.imgur.com/FDguJ3P.png[/img]


[b]Hollow theories - community contest[/b]

Do you like writing? Are you into the craziest theories? 'Hollow' for sure leaves room for some wacky stories!

We give you a chance to let your imagination run free! If you feel like sharing with us your stories about 'Hollow' and what really happened on board a Shakhter-One ship, don't hesitate and take part in our contest!

[b]Rules:[/b]
1. Write a story about what, in your opinion, really happened on board a Shakhter-One ship (up to 3 stories per entry)
2. Send it to us at pr@forever-entertainment.com
3. The contest starts at 16 November 2017 at 21:30 CET, and ends on 30 November 2017 at 23:59 CET
4. We will choose the best stories and send prize to the winners!

[b]Prize:[/b]
Authors of the best fan-made theories, chosen by us, will receive a package with original 'Hollow' soundtrack, syringe-like pen, official 'Hollow' t-shirt, monster figurine, and ID card from the game.


Don't miss your chance, good luck!
-------
[b]Read contest rules here:[/b] https://www.dropbox.com/sh/mqj0plaqplgvbw9/AACUZVBKlr8ny1I-H-9vdzAoa?dl=0

notes.title: Hollow Demo v1.6.4 | patch notes and update 06.06.2017
notes.content:
It's been a very busy month for us and after Digital Dragons and Pixel Haven (maybe some of you have met us there?) we have a major update for you!

Thank you all for your incredible response after playing Hollow demo! We've listened to your feedback and we're happy to present you an update with some major bug fixes and new features suggested by you.

[b]UPDATE[/b][list]
[*]Minimap for easier navigation through maps
[*]Added V-sync
[*]Option to invert mouse axis
[*]Improved game performance
[*]Added volumetric lighting
[*]Tutorial and hints for new players
[*]Added new plot details for better storytelling
[*]Lower difficulty for the reactor puzzle
[*]EXPLODING HEADS! ;) No more skulls rolling around
[*]and a few more minor fixes[/list]

----------------------------------------------------

To był dla nas bardzo zapracowany miesiąc! Po Digital Dragons i Pixel Haven (może spotkaliście nas tam?) wracamy do was z nowym updatem!

Dziękujemy wam za niesamowite zaangażowanie i wszystkie sugestie, które dostaliśmy od was po zagraniu w demo Hollow! Wysłuchaliśmy wszystkich opinii i z radością prezentujemy wam nowy update z bug fixem i nowymi opcjami zasugerowanymi przez was.

[b]UPDATE[/b][list]
[*]Minimapa dla łatwiejszego poruszania się po lokacjach
[*]Dodany V-sync
[*]Opcja odwrócenia osi myszki
[*]Poprawiona wydajność gry
[*]Dodane światło wolumetryczne
[*]Nowy tutorial i podpowiedzi dla nowych graczy
[*]Dodane nowe szczegóły dotyczące historii w grze
[*]Łatwiejsza zagadka z reaktorem
[*]WYBUCHAJĄCE GŁOWY! ;) Nigdy więcej walających się czaszek
[*]i kilka mniejszych poprawek[/list]

notes.title: Do you want to be a part of our game?
notes.content:
Hello! We have some special contest for all game lovers around world! Did you ever dreamed to be a part of game? We are giving you this possibility! We left some special place for whispering voices in our upcoming sci-fi survival-horror game - Hollow.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/590970

I don’t want to spoil in game plot to much but I can tell that in some special place there main character will hear some voices and this is place for YOU!

So, what exactly you have to do to be one of voice actors of Hollow?

I will put it one few points:

1. Grab your mic, smartphone or whatever device that can record audio and record one of phrases (or all!) from list below.
2. You can also record short movie showing how you are acting during voice recording and upload it to YT or somewhere.
3. Send link to us (or file).
4. Wait for results! (beginning of April) 

What you will get in return if your voice acting will be used in Hollow? ETERNAL GLORY!!!:-) And… also your name will be in Credits (Hollow is planned for PC, Xbox One and PS4) and you will get free Steam key for Hollow beta. Also we will have some special gadgets from Hollow to giveaways for best voice actors!

Another question: what language should I use? Answer: ANY! Yes absolutely ANY! Actually more exotic = better! 

————————————————————————————
Texts for voice acting:

There are three categories:

1. Pessimistic (unhappy) 
- Don’t do this!
- It is not right!
- You disappoint her!
- All will suffer because of you!
- He knows!
- End is near!
- I have a bad feeling about this!;-)

2. Optimistic (euphoric)
- I Love you.
- Yes! I do! 
- Just keep up good work!
- Great job!
- Ha Ha Ha (happy laughing)
- Happy Birthday to you! (sung)
- I Knew that you make it!

3. Gore (some crazy voices)
- Bloood!
- GUTS!
- Let’s rip off their skin!
- Let’s look inside her!
- Take his brain out!
- Kill! Kill! Kill now! More! We need more!!!
- Pain!!!

Above texts are our proposition but we are open for any ideas so record!!!
————————————————————————————-


How to contact us? Write to kamila.debicka@forever-entertainment.com

or contact us by our official social media chanels:

FB https://www.facebook.com/ForeverEntert/
Instagram: http://instagram.com/foreverentert
Twitter https://twitter.com/foreverentert?lang=pl
